item.title: BoJ’s Ueda says will closely watch impact of Middle East developments on domestic, overseas economy
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Wednesday that wages need to increase significantly for Japan to sustainably, stably achieve BoJ's price target. Ueda added that he will closely watch impact of Middle East developments on domestic and overseas economy.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Watching market developments closely, prepared to act if needed
item.description: Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Wednesday that he is watching market developments closely and prepared to take various measures if needed.

item.title: The Nasdaq has now completed a Double Top formation
item.description: The NASDAQ has now completed a Double Top formation, beginning on 30th October and completing on 28th January. After this week’s losses, the market is sitting directly on a major support zone where the 200‑day M/A intersects with long‑term trendline support at 24,246.

item.title: Indian Rupee hits record low as USD/INR surges on Oil, risk aversion
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) declines against the US Dollar (USD), extending its losing streak for the fifth successive session. The USD/INR pair reached a fresh record high of 92.58 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Gold sticks to intraday gains above $5,150; upside seems limited amid bullish USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) preserves its modest intraday gains through the Asian session on Wednesday and currently trades just above the $5,150 level, up around 1.30% for the day.

item.title: Pound Sterling weakens to near 1.3300 as geopolitical risks bolster US Dollar
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some sellers to around 1.3310 during the early European session on Wednesday. Escalating conflict in the Middle East triggers a "flight to safety," supporting the US Dollar (USD) against the Pound Sterling (GBP).
